The test image shows a soybean field with widespread yellowing — leaves have yellow margins/interveinal areas with green veins retained. This interveinal chlorosis pattern on upper leaves is a hallmark of Sudden Death Syndrome (SDS).

Let me view one reference image to confirm.

The reference SDS image shows interveinal chlorosis with brown necrosis between veins, green veins retained — a more advanced stage. The test image shows the earlier stage of the same pattern: widespread interveinal yellowing across the whole field canopy, with green veins still visible. The field-wide distribution and yellowing pattern between veins match SDS at an earlier stage.
